description.en: Parthian occupation of Palestine (and Syria) after the invasion of 40 BCE; Roman troops expelled them after Herod's return in 39.
description.ar: احتلال بارثي لفلسطين (وسوريا) بعد غزو 40 ق.م.؛ طردتهم القوات الرومانية بعد عودة هيرودس عام 39.
description.he: כיבוש פרתי של פלשתינה (וסוריה) לאחר הפלישה של 40 לפנה״ס; כוחות רומיים גירשו אותם לאחר שובו של הורדוס ב-39.

sources.quote: returned to Palestine in 39. Shortly afterward Roman troops expelled the Parthians
Now, in the second year, Pacorus, the king of Parthia's son, and Barzapharnes, a commander of the Parthians, possessed themselves of Syria.
Mounting a counterattack in the year 39 BCE, the Romans defeated first Labienus and then Pacorus, who both lost their lives.
the Parthian prince, Pacorus, seized Judea, but he was slain by Publius Ventidius, and the Parthians were thrown back across the Euphrates
